name: Imperial Mandarin
notes: menupages.com (Grubhub/allmenus family, tier 5) had a complete current-looking menu with POS item numbers. Address matches (3904 Convoy St).

name: Bánh Cuốn Phương Nga
notes: No official website listed; menu-buzz.com's listing for this restaurant redirects to placejoys.com, a barred directory farm, and was discarded. Yelp, zmenu.com, checkle.com and restaurant.com all 403/429'd. sagemenu.com and menuweb.menu (tier 5, different owners) both list the same 7 dishes under the same 'Main'/menu structure; prices are close but not identical (menuweb ~$0.11 higher per item, e.g. Crab Paste Vermicelli Soup $7.49 vs $7.60) -- used sagemenu's cleaner cent-formatted figures. This is a genuinely tiny menu -- reviews describe it as 'a limited menu, they specialize in banh cuon dishes' and 'only a few things on the menu' -- so 7 items is treated as the whole menu, not a partial. Party-tray prices mentioned in reviews ($40-50 for a tray feeding 4-7) are not itemized per-dish and were left out.

notes: Business trades as 'Mr. Shawarma' (Mediterranean Grill); work-list name 'Mr. Shwarma' kept as given, address matches (1050 Garnet Ave). Own domain's 'Order Now' button for the Pacific Beach location leads to mrshawarmapb.smartonlineorder.com, a WordPress site running the 'clover-online-orders' plugin -- read directly via its first-party REST API (/wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories then /categories/{uuid}/items), 13 categories, 109 items, prices in integer cents from the restaurant's own Clover POS. Dropped the entire 'Catering' section (19 items, all priced $0 / call-for-quote). Kept 'Daily Specials' (day-specific but real-priced) and 'Family Special' trays (real prices, not catering quotes).
